## Purpose and audience

Product stakeholders and delivery teams use this template to evaluate an outcome before adding it to CloudOps scope.

## User and problem

Identify persona, need, outcome, evidence, and why existing workflows are insufficient.

## Proposed scope

Describe behavior, acceptance criteria, exclusions, dependencies, and demo. Confirm whether it fits Version 1 EC2/S3/IAM scope; out-of-scope requests require product change control.

## Impact review

Address tenant isolation, authorization, AWS permissions, evidence/audit, remediation, AI boundary, accessibility, operations, cost, tests, and documentation. List alternatives and open questions.
